# build project
mkdir build
cd build
cmake ..
cmake --build . --parallel
cd ..

for fuzzers in $(find $SRC -maxdepth 1 -name '*_fuzzer.cc' | grep -v wasm_objdump_fuzzer); do
  fuzz_basename=$(basename -s .cc $fuzzers)
  $CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++20 -I. -Ibuild -Iinclude -Ibuild/include \
  $fuzzers $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE ./build/libwabt.a \
  -o $OUT/$fuzz_basename
done

# wasm_objdump_fuzzer needs to be linked together with binary-reader-objdump.cc
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++20 -I. -Ibuild -Ibuild/include -Iinclude /src/wasm_objdump_fuzzer.cc \
        ./src/binary-reader-objdump.cc $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE ./build/libwabt.a \
        -o $OUT/wasm_objdump_fuzzer
project_yaml:
homepage: "https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt"
language: c++
primary_contact: "sbc@chromium.org"
auto_ccs:
  - "binji@chromium.org"
  - "winstein@gmail.com"
  - "shravanrn@gmail.com"
  - "endermoneymod@gmail.com"
sanitizers:
 - address
 - memory
 - undefined
architectures:
 - x86_64
 - i386
main_repo: 'https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt'

fuzzing_engines:
  - afl
  - honggfuzz
  - libfuzzer

FROM gcr.io/oss-fuzz-base/base-builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y cmake libtool make python
RUN git clone --recursive https://github.com/WebAssembly/wabt
WORKDIR wabt
RUN git submodule init
RUN git submodule update
COPY run_tests.sh build.sh *_fuzzer.cc $SRC/
